answer: MediQuick Ibuprofen is contraindicated if you are allergic to ibuprofen, aspirin, or any other NSAID. It should also not be taken if you have an active peptic ulcer or a history of gastrointestinal bleeding related to NSAIDs, are in the last 3 months of pregnancy (third trimester), or have severe heart failure, severe kidney failure, or severe liver failure [ei_a01293014897056b].
